summary: Bradford's Instagram record on parks and environment centres on expanding accessible recreation, maintaining basic park services, opposing facility closures, and advancing climate-related infrastructure like EV charging and district energy. Bradford has consistently advocated for protecting Toronto's ravines (notably Small's Creek), expanding tree canopy, and supporting Toronto's net-zero-by-2040 target. Bradford opposes closing rinks (including Weston Arena), the toboggan ban, and cutting Dentonia Golf Course, and has criticized City performance on summer pool openings, washroom availability, and park cleanliness. Bradford opposes encampments in parks and brought a "Protect Parks and Playgrounds" motion. More recently, Bradford has criticized a "tree equity" policy and a $35M Parks budget increase with new staff hires, framing accountability before headcount. Bradford also championed pickleball, cricket, and disc golf facilities, and supported alcohol-in-parks and lifting the toboggan ban.
